# kitchen_cabinet — ObjectModel reconstruction

**Validation:** PASS ✅ · simulator replay error **2.657 mm** (track noise σ≈1.05 mm → unexplained error **0.671 mm**) · stable: True · URDF≡MJCF within 0.0 mm · labels from: rules

3 links, 2 joints, 48 frames, 480 tracks.

## Joints

| joint | type | parent → child | axis | range | confidence | axis ±° | pivot ±mm | fit rms mm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| door_hinge | revolute | body → door | (+0.000, +0.000, -1.000) | -0.0° … 82.5° | 1.000 | 0.01 | 0.06 | 0.32 |
| drawer_slide | prismatic | body → drawer | (+0.003, -1.000, -0.005) | -0.9 … 226.9 mm | 1.000 | 0.04 | 0.00 | 1.89 |

## Links

| link | material | mass kg | size mm | replay rms mm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| body | wood (fill 0.25) | 36.787 | 604 × 505 × 804 | 2.41 |
| door | wood (fill 0.25) | 0.512 | 301 × 25 × 453 | 2.429 |
| drawer | wood (fill 0.25) | 0.152 | 282 × 25 × 144 | 3.077 |

## How to read this

- **confidence**: BIC posterior of the joint type (fixed / prismatic / revolute).
- **axis ±° / pivot ±mm**: frame-bootstrap spread; large values mean the motion range was too small.
- **replay rms**: the exported MJCF is compiled in MuJoCo, driven with the estimated joint states, and every simulated surface point is compared with the observed tracks.
- Damping and friction cannot be identified from motion alone and are defaults.
